note: College-specific timetable rules. The optimiser obeys them and the independent checker counts every break. strength: must = never broken (where the college's own timetable already keeps it), prefer = avoided, and never more often than the college does. Rule types: see app/rules.py.

rules.text: Mentoring stays exactly where the college has it.
rules.why: Mentors and their groups plan around these fixed hours.

rules.text: M.Tech and PhD classes stay exactly where the college has them.
Classes run with other departments (open electives, JPAL) stay where they are.
rules.why: Their teachers and rooms belong to other departments, so CSE can't move them.

rules.text: A teacher's lab for two groups of one class is on two different days (e.g. SC Lab A1 Thursday, A2 Friday).
rules.why: Teachers don't take the same lab twice in one day. Pairs the college itself holds on one day may stay.

rules.text: No class for the whole section after JPAL on that day.
rules.why: Only about 20 of 150 D4 students take JPAL. A class after it would make everyone else wait through JPAL for it.

rules.text: Every weekday has at least one real lecture or lab, not just the open elective, major project, mentoring or JPAL.
rules.why: College rule: students must have proper classes on every working day. (1st-year subjects are taught by Applied Sciences and are not in CSE's timetable.)
